one_line: Crown Prince of Manipur and commander who led the Meitei resistance in the Anglo-Manipur War of 1891.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to early 30s, athletic and wiry with a soldier’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with sharp cheekbones, medium-brown Meitei complexion, straight nose, defined jaw, and intense dark eyes; brows slightly furrowed, default expression a focused, calm determination with a hint of defiance.
appearance.hair: Thick, straight black hair pulled back into a neat high knot at the back of the crown, secured with a simple dark wooden stick; short, tidy sideburns and no beard; no helmet, leaving the knot and forehead clearly visible.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate late-19th-century Meitei noble-warrior attire: a long-sleeved, knee-length white cotton tunic (phijom) with a straight collar and subtle woven borders, worn over a deep-red cotton wrapper dhoti tied tightly around the waist and pleated in front, ending mid-calf; a broad dark-indigo cotton waist-sash wrapped twice and knotted to the left with its end hanging; over the shoulders a light cream, thin cotton shawl (phanek-like wrap adapted as a warrior’s angavastra) with a narrow red border, usually draped over the left shoulder and under the right arm; simple but dignified jewellery—narrow brass armlets on both upper arms, a single brass bangle on the right wrist, and a small round brass stud in each ear; on his feet soft dark-brown leather sandals with a toe loop; no modern gear, fabrics visibly handwoven.
appearance.signature: A long, straight, Indian-pattern cavalry sabre with a slightly curved steel blade, brass hilt and knuckle guard, and a dark-brown leather scabbard worn slung from the left side of his waist-sash, often drawn and held in his right hand with the blade angled down.

ref_desc: Tikendrajit Singh is a late-20s Meitei prince with medium-brown skin, intense dark eyes, black hair in a high knot, wearing a white knee-length tunic, deep-red dhoti, dark-indigo waist-sash, cream shawl, brass armlets, leather sandals, and carrying a brass-hilted sabre in a brown scabbard.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character sheet of Tikendrajit Singh, a late-19th-century Meitei prince and commander: a late-20s athletic man with medium-brown skin, an oval face, sharp cheekbones, intense dark eyes, and a calm but defiant expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a neat high knot at the back of the crown, secured with a simple dark wooden stick, with short tidy sideburns and no beard. Dress him in historically accurate Manipur noble-warrior clothing: a long-sleeved, knee-length white cotton tunic with a straight collar and subtle woven borders, worn over a deep-red cotton dhoti wrapped tight at the waist and pleated in front, ending mid-calf. Around his waist, show a broad dark-indigo cotton sash wrapped twice and knotted to the left, its loose end hanging, and over his shoulders a light cream thin cotton shawl with a narrow red border, draped from the left shoulder across the chest and under the right arm like a warrior’s angavastra. Add simple dignified jewellery: narrow brass armlets on both upper arms, a single brass bangle on his right wrist, and small round brass studs in each ear. On his feet, show dark-brown soft leather sandals with a toe loop. His signature weapon is a slightly curved cavalry sabre with a steel blade, a brass hilt and knuckle guard, and a dark-brown leather scabbard hanging from his left side sash; in one view he holds the drawn sabre in his right hand with the blade angled down. Use a palette of white, deep red, dark indigo, cream, and brass-gold, and present front, side, and back poses that clearly display his face, high knot hair, garments, sandals, and sabre for consistent redrawing.
